written_by: Claude Code, area codes and names drafted for a person to check and fill
notes: The Cal-GETC areas for the Plan (spec 24 → Data, ge_areas), from the official Cal-GETC standards. The area codes and names are drafted from memory, not from the standards, so each row has a todo to confirm them; add, remove or rename areas to match the standards exactly. courses (how many courses the area needs) and units (the units the area needs) are left empty for a person to fill from the standards. An area met inside another area's course, like a lab met by the lab part of a science course, gets courses 0 and units 0. Fill in source_name, source_url (the standards document), academic_year (the standards' year, like 2026-27) and retrieved_at (the day you checked), and delete the todo. A second person checks each row against the standards. Then run: npm run import -- data/raw/planning/cal-getc.json --dry-run
